payload.title: 1. Decide the open questions and record the baseline
payload.description:
Before any stage. (a) Ryan answers the questions at the end of docs/distinctive-bump-plan.md: more than two releases in a day; how the app-shell stack is applied and the right email values for infra/site.json; the tenant for Distinctive (PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID with adopt-tenant-data, or untenanted plus --tenant); responsibilities and the rung; who merges stage pull requests; other sites in the hold-lift window; whether the model key is valid; Gherkin for the build-spec check. (b) Record the baseline read-only: sitemap.xml (42 URLs on 2026-11-17), a text hash of five sample pages (home, a ruling, the docket archive, a section page, the newsletter sign-up), index status of every table, the 14 completed TRIGGER rows, the CloudFormation root stack status.
Acceptance:
Scenario: The plan can start
  Given the baseline is recorded on this task and the questions are answered
  Then task 2 can start
